summary: The diff shows 17 modified frontend files. The changes appear to revert glassmorphism site-wide card/section styling back to solid nexiris-navy bordered cards, while retaining glassmorphism only in Navigation and InquiryModal (glass-nav, glass-panel, glass-btn utilities). The index.css retains glass utilities scoped to nav/modal. All three pages (Home, Annual Program, Our Legacy) are present and use solid card styling. The revert appears largely complete per the acceptance criteria, with no new design features introduced.
